title: Stacked Faces Collage
description: Layered collage depicting a large frontal torso-and-face form constructed from ink drawing, silver foil, and gold-leaf strips. Three pairs of eyeglasses — red, green bowler-hatted, and cream — are stacked vertically on the figure, alongside a heart motif, postage stamps, and an arrow cutout.
composition: central frontal figure with stacked facial elements
